themesSubtitle: Shape a storefront that feels at home in the Gulf. Start with Zaydak Default — more themes can join later.

placeholders.navigationBody: Menus your shoppers follow from header to checkout. Coming in a later release.
placeholders.preferencesBody: Password protection and storefront preferences. Coming in a later release.

selectASection: Select a section to edit its settings.
heroContentHint: Store name, description and logo are managed from Brand and General settings.
collectionOrderHint: Selected collections appear in this order.
valuesHint: This section contains platform-provided customer trust information. The text is managed by Zaydak and cannot be edited.
storyHint: Content comes from your store information.
headerPlaceholder: Shared storefront header. Not editable in this version.
footerPlaceholder: Shared storefront footer. Not editable in this version.
brandColorsHint: Brand colors are managed from Store settings.
previewLocaleHint: The preview uses mock storefront copy. Dashboard language and the live storefront language can differ.
warningDeals: This section will not currently appear to shoppers. At least 3 discounted products are required.
warningTrending: This section will not currently appear to shoppers until enough products have recent views.
warningTicker: This section will not currently appear to shoppers until enough collections or tags are selected.

library.title: Theme library
library.subtitle: Examples of a custom theme. Preview one, and contact us if you want a theme made for your store.

doughn.name: Doughn
doughn.description: A bakery that opens at 4 a.m. The shutter rolls up as shoppers scroll, the sun comes up, and the bread lands on a live bake board.

hullo.name: Hullo
hullo.description: A walk-up coffee window. The sign lands on the wall as you scroll, then a menu, a cup you build, and a camera roll.

drip.name: Drip
drip.description: A gelato bar in Jeddah. Stack scoops on a cone, then scroll through how it's made.

rail.name: Rail
rail.description: Pieces on a rail. Hover turns one toward you, and a click opens it.

personne.name: Personne
personne.description: A coat on nobody. Scroll and it fills out, then six pieces wait on a rail.

jurat.name: Jurat
jurat.description: An oud workshop in Riyadh. Scroll builds one rib by rib, then the wall of ouds, strings, and the bench.
